title: Attestation workflow and immutable audit store for cost-suggester apply/rollback
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement an auditable, attestation-first change control flow for automated batching/caching recommendations and safe apply/rollback. The cost-suggester service currently emits suggested config deltas (batch sizes, cache TTLs, quantization profiles). This ticket defines and implements the server-side sign-off, RBAC gates, tamper-evident logging, and rollback orchestration so that automated suggestions can be safely auto-applied for low-risk customers and require attestation for higher-risk changes. Scope: design authz mapping, create a cryptographically signed attestation envelope for every change, write-change to immutable append-only audit store (WAL-based or cloud KMS-backed), provide an emergency rollback API, integrate with Console rollout UI and webhook notifications, and validate retention/forensics policy for compliance audits. Out of scope: suggestion heuristics tuning and model-level quantization changes that require manual review (handled in a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Each suggested config change must produce an attestation object signed with a per-tenant key before being executed
RBAC policy mapping available in Console for: suggester.execute, suggester.auto_approve, suggester.rollback, suggester.audit_read
All applied changes are appended to an immutable audit store with SHA-256 chaining and retention metadata visible to Compliance team
Rollback operation can revert a change within the last 72 hours and is itself recorded as an attested operation
Security review signoff recorded and security_review_required flag set for prod tenants with regulatory labels
End-to-end test harness that simulates approval flows, auto-apply, and rollback in staging with at least 90% branch coverage for new code paths
tasks: Design: attestation envelope schema and key rotation plan
AuthZ: add RBAC rules, map roles to Console actions, update infra policy docs
Storage: implement append-only audit stream with content-addressed chaining
API: add /suggester/v1/apply, /suggester/v1/rollback endpoints with signed payloads
Console: add signoff UI and audit viewer rows for suggester changes
Ops: run migration for existing suggestions into audit store for last 30 days
QA: create automated tests and a canary playbook for staged rollouts
Docs: write runbook and compliance FAQ for Security/Legal teams

2025-02-21 — Lina Gomez (Security): Reviewed key-rotation plan. Recommend HSM-backed signing for enterprise tenants; OK to use KMS for self-serve tier. Added following actions to tasks.

2025-03-01 — Priya Nair (Compliance): Confirmed retention policy template (7y/90d/30d tiers) and requested a searchable index for audit queries. Added to docs task.

notes: Trade-off: immutable store increases S3/Cold storage cost but simplifies e-discovery and tamper evidence
Fallback: changes that fail attestation are automatically queued for manual review; we will expose a telemetry badge in Console
Future: consider Merkle-ledger or transparency log if multiple services need cross-tenant auditing
